subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Impudent
solution:
The correct answer is '**Polite**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Impudent**' is '**Polite**'.
 
• **Impudent**: very rude; lacking respect and not polite. (बहुत अशिष्‍ट; आदरभाव और नम्रता से रहित, निर्लज्ज)
 
 
• *Example: The boy was punished for his **impudent** behavior/attitude.*
 
 
 
• **Polite**: having good manners and showing respect for others. (सुशील और दूसरों का सम्‍मान करने वाला; नम्र, शिष्‍ट)
 
 
• *Example: The assistants in that shop are always very helpful and **polite**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Polite.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Insolent**: lacking respect; rude. (अवमानक; अभद्र, धृष्‍ट, गुस्‍ताख़)
 
• **Confident**: feeling or showing that you are sure about your own abilities, opinions, etc. (स्‍वयं की योग्‍यताओं, विचारों पर विश्‍वस्‍त; आत्‍मविश्‍वासी)
 
• **Triumphant**: feeling or showing great happiness because you have won or succeeded at something. (विजय या सफलता की प्राप्ति पर अत्‍यंत प्रसन्‍न; विजयोल्‍लसित)
